# Starta Markets

> Bilingual (Arabic/English) market-intelligence platform for the Egyptian
> Exchange (EGX): live prices, 20 years of financial statements, technicals
> and analyst estimates for 300+ listed companies; NAV and performance for
> Egyptian mutual funds (history back to 2010); EGX market news in Arabic and
> English; and a beginner investing academy. All figures in EGP unless stated.
> Prices refresh every 15 minutes during EGX trading hours (Sun–Thu); fund
> NAVs update twice daily; financial statements weekly.

## Companies
- [EGX companies directory](https://startamarkets.com/companies): all Egyptian Exchange listed companies with price, sector and market cap, updated daily
- [EGX sectors](https://startamarkets.com/sectors): companies grouped by sector with counts and market caps (per-sector pages: /sectors/{sector})
- [EGX movers](https://startamarkets.com/markets/movers): today's top gainers, losers and most active stocks
- [EGX 30 index](https://startamarkets.com/markets/egx30): live EGX 30 benchmark value, day change, 52-week range and its 30 constituents (Arabic: /ar/markets/egx30)
- [Dividend calendar](https://startamarkets.com/markets/dividend-calendar): upcoming and recent EGX dividend ex-dates and payouts
- [Arabic company pages](https://startamarkets.com/ar/symbol/COMI-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D9%86%D9%83-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AC%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A): بالعربية — pattern /ar/symbol/{TICKER}-{arabic-company-slug} (a bare /ar/symbol/{TICKER} redirects there)
- [Company pages](https://startamarkets.com/symbol/COMI): per-symbol live price, key statistics, financials, dividends, technicals and news (URL pattern: /symbol/{TICKER}; data pages: /symbol/{TICKER}/financials, /dividends, /technicals, /history)

## Mutual funds
- [Funds marketplace](https://startamarkets.com/Funds): Egyptian mutual funds with NAV, returns and fees, in Arabic and English
- [Best-performing funds 2026](https://startamarkets.com/Funds/best-mutual-funds-egypt-2026): ranked by trailing 1-year return with methodology
- [Fund comparisons](https://startamarkets.com/Funds/vs/2662-vs-2666): side-by-side NAV/returns/fees (pattern: /Funds/vs/{id}-vs-{id})
- [Fund prices today](https://startamarkets.com/Funds/prices-today): every fund's latest unit NAV with its own as-of date, alphabetical (Arabic: /ar/Funds/prices-today)
- [Fund categories compared](https://startamarkets.com/Funds/categories): funds per category with median 1-year and YTD returns and median management fee (Arabic: /ar/Funds/categories); per-category pages: /Funds/category/{money-market|fixed-income|equity|gold|balanced|shariah}
- [Fund providers league table](https://startamarkets.com/Funds/providers): every bank and asset manager with fund count, median 1-year return, best fund and lowest fee (Arabic: /ar/Funds/providers); per-provider pages: /Funds/provider/{slug}
- [Fund risk league table](https://startamarkets.com/Funds/risk): annualized volatility, maximum drawdown, downside deviation and CAGR for every fund with enough NAV history, least volatile first (Arabic: /ar/Funds/risk)
- [Fund fees compared](https://startamarkets.com/Funds/fees): management, subscription and redemption fees side by side (Arabic: /ar/Funds/fees)
- [Compare two funds](https://startamarkets.com/Funds/Compare): interactive comparison tool (Arabic: /ar/Funds/Compare)

## Arabic (العربية)
- [البورصة المصرية اليوم](https://startamarkets.com/ar): Arabic market hub — live EGX30, prices, movers, funds, news
- [أسهم البورصة المصرية](https://startamarkets.com/ar/companies): all EGX companies in Arabic
- [أفضل صناديق الاستثمار في مصر](https://startamarkets.com/ar/Funds/best-mutual-funds-egypt-2026): Egyptian mutual funds ranked by return, in Arabic

## News
- [EGX market news](https://startamarkets.com/News): Arabic and English coverage of the Egyptian market, ~30 articles/day
- [RSS feed (English)](https://startamarkets.com/feed.xml): latest English EGX news as RSS 2.0
- [RSS feed (Arabic)](https://startamarkets.com/ar/feed.xml): latest Arabic EGX news as RSS 2.0

## Methodology and trust
- [Methodology](https://startamarkets.com/methodology): data sources and refresh cadence, how every return and risk figure is computed (window anchors, cadence-aware volatility, drawdown, CAGR), the per-fund data-quality grades, the missing-vs-zero rule and the currency rules (Arabic: /ar/methodology)
- [Editorial policy](https://startamarkets.com/editorial-policy) · [Corrections](https://startamarkets.com/corrections) · [About](https://startamarkets.com/about)

## Full data extract
- [llms-full.txt](https://startamarkets.com/llms-full.txt): current EGX30 value, top-25 companies with prices/PE/yield, top-10 funds, and all glossary definitions (EN+AR) — quotable figures with as-of timestamps

## Learn
- [Investing academy](https://startamarkets.com/Learn): bilingual beginner guides (stock market, mutual funds, NAV, dividends, risk)
- [Financial glossary](https://startamarkets.com/Learn/glossary): 45 EGX and Egypt-market terms defined in English and Arabic (/ar/Learn/glossary)

## Tools
- [AI market analyst](https://startamarkets.com/AiChat): ask about any EGX stock or fund in Arabic or English
- [Market pulse](https://startamarkets.com/Market-Pulse): live EGX market overview
